articles.title: BSC’s quantum defense works. The trade-off is 40% slower transaction throughput.
articles.snippet: BSC’s quantum-security test worked, but bigger transaction data slowed network throughput by about 40%.

articles.title: Bitcoin Faces Greater Quantum Computing Risk Than Ethereum, Citi Warns
articles.snippet: Both Bitcoin and Ethereum face a quantum computing threat, but Citi says the gap between them comes down to governance, not just technology.
